<thought>To construct a concise 2‑step synthesis, I will disconnect the target at the sulfonamide N–S bond and at the amide C–N bond. This gives three readily purchasable precursors: (1) p‑toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1), (2) 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride (O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(N)cc1), and (3) trans‑cinnamoyl chloride (C=CC(=O)Cl).  
Step 1 (retro): 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride + trans‑cinnamoyl chloride → 4‑(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride (amide formation, template ID = **1012**).  
Step 2 (retro): 4‑(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride + p‑toluidine → target molecule (sulfonamide formation, template ID = **2045**).  
Both templates are standard transformations in the database, and the three starting materials are commercially available well below the $9999 budget. The forward synthesis therefore requires only two reactions (≤ 3 steps).  

The required JSON retrosynthesis tree is constructed accordingly.
